results.title: Keely Hodgkinson loses European crown in thrilling 800m final
results.description: It was billed as the race of the championship and, for the neutral, it did not disappoint. For Keely Hodgkinson, however, it was confirmation of a new reality. Switzerland’s Audrey Werro, fresh from suffering a heavy fall in Thursday’s semi-final, confirmed her status as the new pre-eminent force in women’s 800m running by holding off the British Olympic champion in a thrilling finish.
